raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: It incorrectly inferred that Gimme Shelter was Oscar-nominated based on a generic Oscars.org page describing Albert Maysles as an “Oscar-nominated” filmmaker and listing Gimme Shelter among his works. This does not confirm a nomination for that film, and no verification was made in the official Awards Database. The claim was false (and cited the wrong ceremony year), leading to the wrong conclusion; in fact, LaLee’s Kin was the Oscar-nominated film (Best Documentary Feature, 2002).
